remarks: Charming, updated Vintage Farmhouse close to downtown in a delightful, desirable, walk to town-neighborhood. Offering fabulous sunlit entertaining rooms, with hardwood floors and great flow. A perfect scenario for family and friend get-togethers. Upon entering the home, you are greeted by an inviting and bright living room that has been opened to the once formal Dining Room. One can access the spacious Kitchen from the Dining room and/or the TV Den. The well appointed kitchen offers granite counter tops, a center island, Stainless appliances and easy access to the oversized Belgian block patio, ideal for yearly grilling. Just off the kitchen, there is a cozy den optimal for movie nights or the perfect book. Wander upstairs and gracing the second floor, there is a private Primary bedroom suite with its own full bath and dual closets. 2 additional guest bedrooms with an updated hall bath & tub round out this upper floor. If additional space is needed, there is a pull down attic for storage, along w/ a finished lower level with exterior access and wall-to-wall carpeting, offering rec/play space or additional guest space in addition to a separate Laundry Room w/ storage. Outside, you will be pleasantly surprised by the fully fenced spacious play yard that abuts town owned open-space and sports a beautiful and private, spacious patio, along with 2 very large portioned-off gardening beds, just waiting to be tilled. The 2-car garage is as-is and ideal for additional storage need
